implementation_ancestry.adaptation_scope: Only explicit selection/admission gate, pinned official opponent, prospective disjoint opening order and corresponding identity/result labels; preserve primary match resources/freshness and independent raw replay.

opening_policy.canonical_id: sha256(first4 fields of python-chess legal-EP FEN, ASCII; castling normalized by python-chess)
opening_policy.correlation: No shared primary starting root. Both studies use previously retired development families and a candidate selected by primary outcome; no independence of all chess positions or unbiased global strength estimate is claimed.
opening_policy.deterministic_order: Sort disjoint root IDs ascending by sha256(UTF8(experiment_id + |opening-order-v1| + canonical_id)); take first128 DISTINCT IDs.
opening_policy.pair_color_order: Candidate registered first on even pair_index, official first on odd; reverse colors within each pair.
opening_policy.source_kind: Only already-published, completed and retired development match PGN starting positions; no formal pool or private openings.

prospective_freeze: Primary runtime scores, logs, PGNs, result and artifacts have not been read by this follow-up planner. Its terminal verifier has withheld all outcomes pending this published freeze.

runtime_policy.both_arms: Full strength, Ponder=false, UCI_LimitStrength=false, SyzygyProbeLimit=0, Move Overhead=10, timemargin=0, Threads=1, Hash=64.
runtime_policy.failure: Retain every artifact; zero-move/incomplete/illegal/referee/native failure stops as incomplete. Completed legal clock-forfeit results after played moves count as reported and remain separately tabulated.
runtime_policy.freshness: fastchess restart=on; a new referee and both new engines per reversed pair, as in primary.
runtime_policy.native_execution: Only the admitted single standard windows-2022 public GitHub-hosted job; no local native engine/benchmark, no paid/custom runner.
runtime_policy.stopping: No SPRT, draw/resign adjudication, outcome stopping, pair recovery, outcome retry or seed change.
runtime_policy.timing: UTC environment; retain timeleft=true, latency=true, nodes=true PGNs, complete trace log and events, command/process/start/end/runtime hashes.

selection.receipt_gate: No gameplay workflow is present at prospective freeze. A later activation may add the exact independently verified complete primary receipt, its explicit raw ZIP/member/result/audit hashes and a hash-pinned admission workflow only. No gameplay may run before revalidation of those actual bytes.
selection.tie: Use unedited Shawn Xu test1758 parent68752b; no discretionary selection.
selection.validity: Exactly128 reversed pairs/256 games, all raw artifacts/hash/PGN/clock accounting and independent audit verified by the primary terminal reviewer. Actual complete GitHub run and artifact ZIP/member hashes must be explicitly bound before dispatch.

statistics.followup_nomination: No further model choice, outcome-dependent retry or formal alpha decision is authorized by this experiment.
statistics.interval: Exact integer empirical paired-bootstrap polynomial exponent128; normalization128^128; nominal95% central percentiles smallest k with40*CDF(k)>=q*128^128,q=1,39; descriptive only.
statistics.sample: All128 pairs/256 games only. Candidate and correct pinned official wins/draws/losses, colors, paired pentanomial, clock losses and timestamps.
statistics.separation: Report primary same-executable edited-vs-parent and this selected composite-vs-official estimate separately. Do not pool estimates or claim formal/global verified gain.
